description: Read an issue's checklist — the '- [ ]' lines of its description — as items, in order: each with a stable 'id' (pass it to check_checklist_item), 'checked', its words ('text', without reminder or picture), its 'depth' when nested, its 'reminder' ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' or null) and its 'picture' — the attachment it shows of how the item should look, with the 'content' address its bytes are read at with this same token, or null. Needs only permission to see the issue.
name: get_checklist
